script_text:
Stop, Pisces, the stars are screaming at you now!
Mercury is squaring Neptune, your ruling planet, across the 3rd House of communication, turning thoughts into whispers that mislead. This jittery energy fuels misunderstandings in your social circle and pulls you into daydreams instead of facts.
In love, Venus moves through your 5th House of romance, urging you to trust your gut over doubt; if single, a mysterious water-element sign will be drawn to your artistic aura.
Your 10th House of career receives a supportive sextile from Jupiter, opening a hidden freelance opportunity that pays more than expected. Money-wise, a subtle shift in the 2nd House brings unexpected windfalls if you act now.
Beware of procrastination; seize the moment or you’ll miss the lucky break the cosmos offers.
Follow for tomorrow's reading today so you never miss the stars' next move.
